generation.scope: Classifies every finite-edge maximal-tangent AS window whose ternary point scheme is a smooth plane cubic graph. The translation has exact order two or four. Every smooth base and every nonzero class in its nine-dimensional correction space is regular with finite edges. An effective divisor of degree twelve together with the polarized cubic and translation decides unmarked indexed isomorphism and all periods. The two irreducible nine-dimensional families have generic periods two and four. The previously known elliptic nine-parameter Ore family is dense in the first.

open_mathematics: At the boundary of the smooth elliptic base compute the ternary recurrence and the values of mixed corrections at the fixed singular points. Prove the nodal cases and whether a quantum-base window can be smoothed by lifting all its correction eigenvectors. Exclude cuspidal and projective-plane bases where justified. The unrestricted finite edges without a maximal tangent point, positive-dimensional windows and ordinary rank-15 exceptional locus still require work.
